verdict.rationale: LaunchDarkly offers a $0-forever tier with unlimited flags (docs-70). Its docs cover flag creation (docs-19), environments through production (docs-58) and a CLI for managing flags (docs-61). Hands-on users confirm flag changes stream live to running apps via server-sent events (comm-7, comm-12). missing for 10: no documented quickstart or onboarding flow proving the signup-to-production toggle happens 'within minutes'; the only hands-on time data is an implementation done in a 24-hour hackathon (comm-5); no independent time-to-first-flag corroboration.
